Никакого explicit-контента, никакого namёka на несовершеннолетних — персона канонически 26 лет.

camera_flaws раздаются по кадрам по кругу: каждый снимок получает свой огрех живой съёмки.
Сходство и пластик — РАЗНЫЕ рычаги. Сходство: вес PuLID/LoRA вверх. Пластик: guidance вниз, детейлер выключить, denoise апскейла вниз. Не путать их между собой.
camera_flaws: handheld frame tilted a degree or two off level
slightly underexposed, shadows crushed a little
one highlight blown out where the light hits hardest
focus landing a touch behind the eyes, sharpest on the ear
faint haze from a smudge on the front element
slight motion blur in one hand from a slow shutter
subject a little off-centre with one shoulder cropped by the frame edge
mild flare washing one corner of the frame
grain heavier in the shadows where the exposure was pushed
colour a touch cool and uncorrected straight out of camera
face_realism_tail: fine lines at the corners of the eyes, natural asymmetry between the two halves of the face, faint freckles across the nose
